model.target: Real hero attacking a real enemy hero
model.flatStats: Continually active bonuses to the holder while the item is in an active slot.
model.friendlyAuras: Stats apply to allies in radius, including the owner.
model.auraStacking: Stack groups apply per stat. Use the strongest amount per group and suppress groups named by blockedBy when present.
model.coverage: Missing fields are unmodelled. Partial items include only the represented stats, auras or effects.
